records.text: Andrew Kolvet said Charlie Kirk declined a PPP loan during the pandemic even though Turning Point USA could have used the money
records.speaker: Andrew Kolvet

appearances.snippet: Said no to the—whatever that check was. ... Yeah, the PPE loans, right? ... I always get PPP and PPE mixed up. ... Yeah, but it was a good amount of money that, at the time, we could have used. ... He put out a company statement saying, you know, this was tempting for sure, but we're going to say no.

verification.notes: TPUSA did apply for PPP loans during pandemic but then rejected them. Claim says 'refused' which implies never applied, but evidence shows they applied then rejected the funds. Mixed because they ultimately did not accept PPP loans but they did initially apply.

sources.title: Pro-Trump Student Group Turning Point USA Applied for, Then Rejected, Coronavirus Aid
sources.relevance: Confirms TPUSA applied for PPP loans worth .2M before rejecting them, not that they simply refused to participate
